title: FB-025 preserve completed job SQLite append rows
summary: Fix FR-024 by preserving append-style completed-job rows in the optional SQLite state mirror when job_id repeats.
reason: Worker finding W06-02 showed completed_jobs uses job_id as a unique upsert key, collapsing repeated source-identity completions that remain distinct in the authoritative JSONL manifest.
behavior_before: record_completed_job used job_id as job_key when present and upserted on completed_jobs.job_key, so repeated job_id writes replaced earlier mirror rows.
behavior_after: completed_jobs schema v2 removes the unique job_key constraint, keeps job_key as a non-unique index, and record_completed_job appends every mirror write.
manual_validation: PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest tests.python.desktop.test_phase4_storage_observability -q passed, 16 tests; tests.python.desktop.test_facade_maintenance_policy tests.python.desktop.test_telemetry_service -q passed, 30 tests.

rollback_plan: Revert the SQLite completed_jobs key/write changes and the duplicate-job-id regression test, then rerun the Phase 4 storage observability tests.
notes: Existing v1 SQLite mirrors migrate by rebuilding completed_jobs without the unique job_key constraint. Previously collapsed rows cannot be recovered, but future writes preserve append semantics.
